metadata.title: Representative Public Seed Profiles
metadata.scope: Small validation sample only. Values are high-level qualitative or broad public ranges and should be refreshed before analytical use.
metadata.safety_note: No exact live troop locations, targeting data, exploitable vulnerabilities, or operationally sensitive real-time dispositions are included.

profiles.summary: Global power-projection military with joint force structure, major alliance commitments, large defense budget, advanced C4I, and substantial strategic transport and sustainment capacity.
profiles.source_notes: Use CIA World Factbook for public country/military descriptors, SIPRI for expenditure time series, NATO for alliance status, and U.S. DoD public releases for force posture summaries.

force_structure_summary.label: joint_global_force
force_structure_summary.notes: Service list only; no unit locations.

logistics_depth.notes: Global sustainment and transport capacity at country level.

alliance_commitments.other: Multiple bilateral and multilateral security commitments.

profiles.summary: Large, modernizing military with strong regional anti-access capabilities, growing blue-water naval reach, centralized party-state command, and major domestic defense-industrial capacity.
profiles.source_notes: Use CIA World Factbook and public defense white papers/official releases; record any country-specific official URL when extending.

nuclear_policy_public.notes: Public policy summary only; do not encode targeting assumptions.

profiles.summary: Large nuclear-armed military with extensive ground, aerospace, naval, missile, and internal security components; current readiness and losses are conflict-sensitive and require date-bound sourcing.
profiles.source_notes: Refresh with dated public sources before use; avoid live operational disposition or tactical loss claims.

force_structure_summary.label: large_multi_service_force
force_structure_summary.notes: Conflict-era values must be separately dated.

training_experience.notes: Public reporting varies by formation and date; keep sparse.

industrial_reconstitution_capacity.notes: Sanctions and wartime production assumptions require source-specific overlays.

profiles.summary: Large military with major land-force commitments, growing maritime and aerospace capabilities, nuclear deterrent, and expanding domestic defense industry.
profiles.source_notes: Use official Indian defense ministry releases and budget documents for extension.

profiles.summary: NATO nuclear-armed military with expeditionary professional forces, advanced maritime/air capabilities, and strong alliance integration.
profiles.source_notes: Use UK Ministry of Defence public documents for detailed public force-structure updates.

profiles.summary: NATO/EU nuclear-armed military with expeditionary capabilities, overseas commitments, advanced aerospace/naval industry, and independent strategic deterrent.
profiles.source_notes: Use French defense ministry and public military programming documents for extension.

profiles.summary: Regional military with regular and parallel revolutionary-guard structures, missile/drone emphasis, layered internal security roles, sanctions-shaped logistics, and high uncertainty in many capability estimates.
profiles.source_notes: Use public institute assessments and official statements carefully; keep proxy or live regional activity out of baseline records unless high-level and dated.

logistics_depth.notes: Sanctions and domestic substitution assumptions require source-specific evidence.

nuclear_policy_public.notes: Model nuclear-policy variables only from public legal/diplomatic sources.

profiles.summary: Highly trained regional military with reserve-heavy mobilization model, advanced air/C4I/intelligence capabilities, active border and internal security pressures, and dense political-legal constraints.
profiles.source_notes: Conflict-era values must be dated; exclude live force locations and tactical readiness details.

profiles.summary: Wartime military with large mobilized force structure, extensive partner support, rapidly adapted doctrine and uncrewed systems use, and high uncertainty in personnel, inventory, readiness, and attrition variables.
profiles.source_notes: Treat all conflict-related values as date-bound; do not include live positions, targeting, tactical force availability, or sensitive aid flow details.

profiles.summary: Self-governing entity with public defense data, reserve and civil-defense emphasis, island geography, high-end air/naval/missile threats in scenario context, and strong dependence on political assumptions.
profiles.source_notes: Use Taiwan Ministry of National Defense public reports for extension; keep sovereignty/status distinct from military variables.

alliance_commitments.other: Security relationships and support assumptions must be scenario overlays, not baseline facts.
